# Command reference

One page per command, generated from the help texts. Every command also
accepts `-h` or `--help`, which prints the same information in the terminal.
The global options are described on the [nemau](nemau.md) page.

- [nemau](nemau.md): Nemau Cloud command-line client
  - [nemau completion](nemau_completion.md): Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
    - [nemau completion bash](nemau_completion_bash.md): Generate the autocompletion script for bash
    - [nemau completion fish](nemau_completion_fish.md): Generate the autocompletion script for fish
    - [nemau completion powershell](nemau_completion_powershell.md): Generate the autocompletion script for powershell
    - [nemau completion zsh](nemau_completion_zsh.md): Generate the autocompletion script for zsh
  - [nemau compute](nemau_compute.md): Instances, images, flavors, keypairs
